purpose: Teach: 半月/高麗/理学部/無害/音痴/科学技術庁/初等/開発途上国

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、月の半月と新月の比較研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the comparison between the half-moon and new moon phases, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant. Leaning in with gentle interest. Measured pace—giving him space to correct or confirm. The cadence of a teacher who already knows the answer but wants to hear him say it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、古代の高麗王朝の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote my paper on ancient Goryeo dynasty research.
lines.style: Careful, slightly uncertain. Pause before the affirmation. Soft, polite tone. He's registering the mismatch but choosing his words carefully, almost apologetically.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、理学部の応用化学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on applied chemistry research in the science department, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gentle follow-up. No accusation in the voice—just a curious re-offering. Slight tilt of interest, as if re-reading a note. Patient.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、無害な殺虫成分の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote my paper on research into harmless insecticide compounds.
lines.style: Quieter this time. A small note of strain underneath the politeness. He knows something's off but is still trying to engage respectfully. Shorter breath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 音痴改善の音楽教育を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your paper covered music education for improving tone deafness, isn't that right?
lines.style: Slightly brighter, as if offering another chance. Hopeful tone. Still warm but with a hint of curiosity about whether he'll catch on. Forward-leaning.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、科学技術庁の研究助成史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote my paper on the history of research grants from the Science and Technology Agency.
lines.style: Strained politeness cracking slightly. He's aware now. Quieter, almost resigned. A micro-pause before each phrase, like he's choosing to keep going despite confusion.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、初等教育のデジタル化を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper examined the digitalization of primary education, didn't it?
lines.style: Gentler now. Less testing, more witnessing. Slower pace. She's moved past confirmation into something closer to compassion. Warm, steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、開発途上国への医療援助を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote my paper on medical aid to developing countries.
lines.style: Small, exhausted. The politeness has worn thin. Brief, like he's just following the ritual now. Fading slightly at the end. A ghost of engagement.
